t2.thesis: NOW enters its print after a sharp run-up (+18% 1m, +9% in 7 days) with a ~10% implied move and three straight large negative post-earnings opens, so the setup is roughly a coin flip with a slight tilt below the base rate.
reasons: Base rate for software AMC events is about 54%, which is the starting point.
The stock has rallied about 18% in a month into the print, so expectations are elevated and a beat may already be priced in.
The last 4 prints all had negative open-to-open returns (-14%, -10%, -0.9%, -0.9%) despite EPS beats, a pattern of selling good news.
The implied move of about 10% is large and symmetric, with call IV above put IV, so options give no clear directional edge.
Fundamentals are strong (24% revenue growth, cRPO +21%, estimates stable), which offsets the crowded-positioning concern.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether cRPO and subscription revenue growth plus Q4 guidance clear the elevated whisper bar after the rally, along with AI ACV and Armis security commentary.
